findingDetails.title: The series phase map includes phase 007 while its binding and closure contract stop at 006
findingDetails.description: The parent spec marks phase 007 Complete, but the parent goal binds only phases 001–006 and defines completion criteria around those six children. Phase 007 still has template placeholders in its goal, and stale acceptance-criteria closure statements in 002, 004 and 005 say the packets are not closeable even where evidence rows are Met. This leaves the series completion authority and phase-007 objective unclear to a cold reader.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The current phase map includes 007 as Complete, the parent goal enumerates only 001–006, and the 007 goal retains fill-in placeholders; stale closure text conflicts with rows marked Met.

claimAdjudication.claim: The current series records phase 007 as complete while its parent binding and completion criteria stop at phase 006, phase 007 has an unfilled goal template, and multiple child closure statements contradict their Met evidence rows.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the mismatch was only an old handover snapshot: the current root phase map marks all seven phases complete, and phase 007 implementation-summary.md records completion_pct 100 and a 2026-11-02 completion date. The handover still directs a fresh session to start 003 and describes 003–006 as unstarted.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: Phase 007 may be a later additive gap-closure packet intentionally outside the original six-child goal. If so, the parent goal and its completion criteria still need to state that boundary because the current parent phase map includes 007 as part of this series.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if the series owner establishes that phase 007 is formally outside the parent completion contract and updates the current phase map or parent-goal scope so the two documents agree.

findingDetails.title: The transcript-sweeps playbook incorrectly says OpenCode and Devin have no live hook
findingDetails.description: The playbook says OpenCode and Devin have no live hook. The OpenCode plugin captures completed question-tool answers at tool.execute.after, and Devin has a configured PostToolUse adapter. The sweep scenario remains useful for recovering missed answers, but its capability explanation is inaccurate.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The playbook statement conflicts with the OpenCode plugin implementation, Devin hook configuration, coverage rationale and feature catalog runtime matrix.

results.notes: The parent phase map includes phase 007 as complete, but the parent binding and completion criteria enumerate only 001–006 and the 007 goal remains a template.
Several closure statements remain No or say work has not started despite rows marked Met and later phase completion summaries.
The target exposes a save command and runtime adapters; no separate dispatched agent contract owns decision-capture behavior.

The catalog, README and live scenario align on Claude, Devin, OpenCode and Pi live capture, Codex save-time capture, and Cursor unverified; the implementation sources inspected confirm OpenCode and Devin live paths.
The feature catalog describes live and save-time capture boundaries and matches the save command and OpenCode implementation.
The transcript-sweeps playbook says OpenCode and Devin have no live hook, contrary to their configured live paths and the coverage rationale.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: The traceability surface spans parent and child completion contracts, acceptance evidence, runtime adapters, catalog entries and interactive playbook scenarios.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Followed the phase and closure contracts to their acceptance rows, then compared advertised runtime capabilities against the runtime matrix, save command, adapters, catalog and playbook scenarios.
omittedHighRiskTargets: Runtime test execution was not in scope for this read-only workflow; maintainability review of test coverage remains for the next dimension.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The parent phase map, parent goal binding and phase-007 goal may describe different closure scopes.

searchActions.queryOrPath: Parent spec phase map; parent goal binding and completion rows; phase-007 objective and completion template.
searchActions.result: Spec phase map lists seven Complete children; parent goal binds and closes only 001–006; phase 007 objective, decisions and criteria are unfilled placeholders.

searchLedger.rationale: The packet does not state whether phase 007 belongs to series closure despite including it in the current phase map.

searchLedger.invariant: A closure statement must agree with the acceptance rows and completion summary it closes.

searchActions.queryOrPath: Child acceptance evidence/status rows and closure anchors for 002, 004 and 005.
searchActions.result: 002 AC-013 and AC-019 are Met but its closure says No and waits for them; 004 and 005 say no work has started while their phase specs and summaries mark completion.

searchLedger.rationale: A reader cannot rely on child closure statements to determine whether acceptance evidence is complete.

searchLedger.invariant: A playbook capability statement must match live adapter paths present in its runtime.

searchActions.queryOrPath: Transcript-sweeps explanation and OpenCode/Devin live-hook registration.
searchActions.result: Playbook claims neither runtime has a live hook; OpenCode has tool.execute.after capture and Devin config invokes its PostToolUse capture adapter.

searchLedger.rationale: The playbook gives operators a false runtime capability model even though save-time recovery remains valid.

searchLedger.invariant: The catalog and coverage matrix should state the same capture mode for each runtime as the code and save command.

searchActions.queryOrPath: Feature catalog runtime table; hooks README decision-capture row; coverage-rationale decision-capture section.
searchActions.result: Catalog and README align: Claude, Devin, OpenCode and Pi capture live; Codex captures at save time; Cursor remains unverified. Coverage rationale gives the Codex save-time rationale.

searchLedger.rationale: The runtime matrix is consistent across the catalog and coverage documents.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Direct comparison shows the catalog and coverage table match current adapter behavior.

searchLedger.invariant: Scenario runtime rows should describe live versus save-time capture and nudge support without relabeling skipped assertions as failures.

searchActions.queryOrPath: Live scenario runtime matrix and check notes; runtime adapters and save-time Codex sweep.
searchActions.result: The matrix distinguishes four live adapters from Codex save-time capture, records Devin nudge output as hidden, and treats Codex live-queue checks as skip; no mismatch was found outside transcript-sweeps prose.

searchLedger.rationale: The live conversation scenario preserves the per-runtime distinction and valid Codex skips.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The runtime matrix and capability summaries align; only transcript-sweeps prose is stale.
